topics.title: Agriculture and farming prospects
topics.objective: Explain the importance, enterprise opportunities and inclusive career prospects of agriculture in Ghana.

topics.title: Emerging technologies in agriculture
topics.objective: Apply digital, biological and controlled-environment technologies to agricultural production decisions.

topics.title: Agricultural machinery
topics.objective: Select, operate and maintain agricultural tools and machinery using safe and efficient practices.

topics.title: Economic production of crops
topics.objective: Plan market-oriented crop production, husbandry, harvesting, post-harvest handling and marketing.

topics.title: Economic production of animals
topics.objective: Apply husbandry, nutrition, health, biosecurity and enterprise records to animal production.

topics.title: Land tenure systems for agriculture
topics.objective: Compare land tenure arrangements and their effects on access, investment and sustainable farm management.

topics.title: Agricultural support systems
topics.objective: Use extension, finance, insurance, farmer organisations and market information to improve farm decisions.

topics.title: Climate variability and agricultural risk
topics.objective: Interpret weather and climate evidence and explain effects on yields, pests, water and rural livelihoods.

topics.title: Climate change adaptation
topics.objective: Select practical farm adjustments that reduce exposure and vulnerability to climate-related hazards.

topics.title: Climate change mitigation
topics.objective: Evaluate agricultural practices that reduce greenhouse-gas emissions or increase long-term carbon storage.

questions.prompt: Which activity belongs to the agricultural value chain rather than only primary production?

options.rationale: This is the supported answer. Agriculture includes production, processing, storage, transport and marketing. Turning cassava into packaged gari adds value and can create employment beyond the farm gate.

options.rationale: This is a plausible misconception, but it does not follow the agricultural principle or evidence established in the worked solution.

options.label: C
options.text: Leaving harvested cassava exposed to rain
options.rationale: This is a plausible misconception, but it does not follow the agricultural principle or evidence established in the worked solution.

options.label: D
options.text: Discarding all farm records
options.rationale: This is a plausible misconception, but it does not follow the agricultural principle or evidence established in the worked solution.

questions.workedSolution: Agriculture includes production, processing, storage, transport and marketing. Turning cassava into packaged gari adds value and can create employment beyond the farm gate. Therefore the correct answer is A: Processing cassava into packaged gari for sale.
